proposals.name: RumorPropagationSystem
proposals.description: Simulates the organic spread and inevitable distortion of information through the population. It governs how memories are shared as conversation topics, mutated by personality traits, and assimilated as hearsay beliefs by listeners.

specification.name: RumorPropagationSystem
specification.description: Simulates the organic spread and inevitable distortion of information through the population. It governs how memories are shared as conversation topics, mutated by personality traits, and assimilated as hearsay beliefs by listeners.
specification.logic: 1. Iterate through agents currently collocated in the same Room. 2. Select a pair of agents (Speaker and Listener) who are not currently performing critical tasks. 3. Speaker selects a high-impact Memory or Belief (e.g., crimes witnessed, unexpected behaviors) to share. 4. Calculate a 'Distortion Factor' based on the Speaker's Personality (honesty/dramatics); if high, modify the memory details (e.g., increase severity, change perpetrator). 5. Compare Speaker's persuasion against Listener's skepticism and their mutual Relationship trust level. 6. If the check passes, the Listener forms a new 'Hearsay' Memory of the event and updates relevant Beliefs about the subject. 7. If the check fails, the Listener gains a negative Belief regarding the Speaker's credibility.

proposals.rationale: Currently, agents have memories and thoughts but no mechanism to transmit narrative data between one another. A rumor system would allow 'Information' to act as a currency, moving through SocialDynamics to trigger GoalSynthesis and create shared beliefs/tensions.

specification.logic: 1. Iterates through all entities possessing Agent, Personality, and Mind components. 2. Calculates a behavior vector based on Personality traits (e.g., aggression, altruism) and current Beliefs. 3. Maps the vector to a narrative archetype (e.g., The Guardian, The Trickster, The Hermit). 4. Scans current Goals for alignment with the determined archetype. 5. Generates a Thought in the Mind component acknowledging this self-perception.

proposals.name: PlotInciterSystem
proposals.description: Monitors simulation entropy and agent stagnation to inject inciting incidents, false beliefs, or urgent needs that disrupt equilibrium and force narrative progression.

specification.name: PlotInciterSystem
specification.description: Monitors simulation entropy and agent stagnation to inject inciting incidents, false beliefs, or urgent needs that disrupt equilibrium and force narrative progression.
specification.logic: 1. Iterate through agents to calculate a 'Drama Score' based on the intensity of recent Memories and the urgency of current Goals. 2. Identify agents in a state of 'Narrative Stagnation' (low drama score/high stability). 3. Select a disruption strategy based on the agent's Personality: A) 'Paranoia' (High Neuroticism): Implant a false Belief that a specific neighbor intends to steal an Item from their Inventory. B) 'Ambition' (High Conscientiousness/Extroversion): Generate a high-priority Goal to secure a contested Room or high-value Item. C) 'Desperation': Artificially spike a Need (e.g., Hunger) to critical levels to force risky resource acquisition. 4. If a latent negative relationship exists without active conflict, synthesize a 'Fabricated Memory' of a recent insult to trigger immediate hostility. 5. Log the inciting incident.

proposals.rationale: Currently, all 17 agents have 0 goals and neutral arousal (0.50). The simulation is in a state of stasis. This system would inject environmental stimuli and 'inciting incidents' (e.g., a shortage, a mysterious arrival, a storm) to trigger the GoalSynthesisSystem and TensionEscalation.

proposals.description: Adjusts the monetary value of items in real-time based on local scarcity (supply) and the physiological necessities of nearby agents (demand).

specification.name: DynamicPriceDiscoverySystem
specification.description: Adjusts the monetary value of items in real-time based on local scarcity (supply) and the physiological necessities of nearby agents (demand).
specification.logic: 1. Iterate through all Agents possessing an Inventory. 2. Group Items by type to determine local Supply counts within the current Room. 3. Scan the Needs of all Agents in the same Position to calculate aggregate Demand (e.g., high average Hunger increases demand for food items). 4. Apply a scarcity algorithm: increase Item value if count is low; decrease if count is high. 5. Apply a desperation multiplier: further increase Item value if local Agents have critical Needs deficits that the Item resolves. 6. Update the 'value' field on the Item component to reflect the new market price.

proposals.rationale: Currently, the MarketExchangeSystem lacks a mechanism to adjust value. By implementing price discovery based on supply (ResourceProductionSystem) and demand (Agent Needs), the simulation creates natural friction and motivation for agents to prioritize specific trades, moving them from zero-goal states to active economic participants.

proposals.name: DynamicValuationSystem
proposals.description: Calculates the subjective utility and exchange value of items for agents based on physiological needs, personality traits, and perceived scarcity.

specification.name: DynamicValuationSystem
specification.description: Calculates the subjective utility and exchange value of items for agents based on physiological needs, personality traits, and perceived scarcity.
specification.logic: 1. Iterates through agents possessing Needs and Inventory. 2. Calculates 'UtilityScore' for items based on Need deficits (e.g., Food value scales with Hunger, Medkit value with Health loss). 3. Applies 'ScarcityMultiplier' by checking Beliefs regarding item availability in the current Room or GridPosition. 4. Adjusts value based on Personality traits (e.g., 'Materialistic' boosts luxury item value, 'Pragmatic' boosts tool value). 5. Updates or creates a Belief regarding the 'FairPrice' and 'PersonalValue' of specific item types. 6. If PersonalValue of a non-possessed item is critical, synthesizes a Goal to 'Acquire_Item'. 7. If PersonalValue of a possessed item is low relative to market belief, marks item in Inventory (via metadata or specific Belief) as tradeable.

proposals.rationale: Currently, agents have zero goals. A DynamicValuationSystem would calculate the 'perceived value' of items based on an agent's Needs component and current market scarcity. This creates 'Value Asymmetry,' which is the primary driver for the GoalSynthesisSystem to generate trade and acquisition goals.

proposals.description: Translates the mathematical reality of dwindling inventory and rising needs into psychological urgency, compelling agents to hoard, overpay, or desperately seek resources based on their personality profiles.

specification.name: ScarcityDriveSystem
specification.description: Translates the mathematical reality of dwindling inventory and rising needs into psychological urgency, compelling agents to hoard, overpay, or desperately seek resources based on their personality profiles.
specification.logic: 1. Iterate through agents with Needs and Inventory. 2. For each critical Need (e.g., Hunger), calculate the 'Survival Buffer' by summing relevant Inventory items. 3. Compare 'Survival Buffer' against the agent's 'AnxietyThreshold' derived from their Personality (Neuroticism/Conscientiousness). 4. If Buffer < Threshold: Generate a 'ScarcityFear' Thought (e.g., 'I do not have enough food for tomorrow'). 5. Synthesize a high-priority Goal: 'Secure [Resource]' with a 'Hoarding' flag, forcing the agent to seek quantities beyond immediate consumption. 6. If Buffer is Critical (near zero): Query Memory for last known location of resource, ignore standard pricing logic (WillingnessToPay = Max), and potentially generate 'Desperation' Goals (Steal/Beg) if Personality permits.

proposals.rationale: Currently, agents have 'Needs' but '0 goals'. This system would bridge that gap by translating low Need values into actionable economic goals (e.g., 'Acquire Bread', 'Earn 5 Gold') within the GoalSynthesisSystem, preventing agent stagnation.

proposals.description: Tracks the agent's proficiency levels across various economic trades and labor types, enabling quality scaling and success checks.

specification.name: ProfessionalExpertise
specification.description: Tracks the agent's proficiency levels across various economic trades and labor types, enabling quality scaling and success checks.

fields.name: skillMap
fields.description: A serialized JSON dictionary mapping labor types (e.g., 'Smithing', 'Farming') to normalized proficiency values (0.0 to 1.0).

fields.name: primarySpecialization
fields.description: The name of the labor type the agent is most adept at or focuses on.

fields.name: learningRate
fields.description: A multiplier (typically 1.0) affecting how quickly proficiency increases when performing labor.

proposals.rationale: Currently, the LaborAssignmentSystem lacks a baseline for productivity. Specialization is the engine of trade; if every agent is equally proficient at all tasks, there is no inherent reason for the Baker to trade with the Miller beyond basic scarcity. Expertise forces inter-dependency and justifies price variance.

proposals.name: FinancialObligationSystem
proposals.description: Orchestrates the lifecycle of economic debts, regulating lending criteria based on risk assessment, applying temporal interest to outstanding obligations tracked in Memory, and generating enforcement Goals for breach of contract.

specification.name: FinancialObligationSystem
specification.description: Orchestrates the lifecycle of economic debts, regulating lending criteria based on risk assessment, applying temporal interest to outstanding obligations tracked in Memory, and generating enforcement Goals for breach of contract.
specification.logic: 1. Scans for Agents with critical Needs deficits and insufficient Inventory (Borrowers) co-located in a Room with Agents holding surplus Inventory (Lenders). 2. Evaluates the Lender's Belief regarding the Borrower's trustworthiness; if sufficient, executes a transfer of items/currency. 3. Writes a structured 'Debt' Memory to both Agents recording principal, interest rate, and deadline. 4. Periodically iterates through active Debt Memories; if the deadline passes without repayment, degrades the Lender's Belief in the Borrower. 5. Generates high-priority Goals: 'Repay Debt' for Borrowers with acquired funds, and 'Enforce Collection' (intimidation or seizure) for Lenders when debts default.

proposals.rationale: The current agent state shows zero goals across the board. Debt is a primary catalyst for goal synthesis (e.g., 'Earn 50 gold to repay Greta'). By allowing agents to trade on credit, you enable complex transactions even when liquidity is low, creating a 'future-facing' economic pressure that drives labor.

fields.name: misinformationIds
fields.description: A serialized list or set of identifiers representing false or outdated information the entity believes to be true.

proposals.rationale: Currently, the RumorPropagationSystem lacks data to move. A Knowledge component containing 'facts', 'secrets', or 'myths' would allow agents to trade, hide, or weaponize information, creating social leverage and driving the NarrativeEvents system.
